notes: Tour 22042 (LENCH15-00), Nordic countries and Iceland, 15 days: no upcoming dates. Its detail (captured 2026-11-13 22:05 UTC, trimmed by public.ts) lists no availableMonths, so the scraper sends no dates request and parse gives no departures; the runner then skips the tour as no-departures (not a failure). memberFee is null, so fromPriceHkd is null. Four gathering places are listed (香港國際機場 and three T1 counters); the first is taken. The tour code has a hyphen (LENCH15-00), which TOUR_CODE_PATTERN allows. Day headings: the route lines start with D1, D2 …, which are stripped before anything else (review round 1; before, they stayed in the heading and the shared day marker removed them); only the first line is read (day 1's second line is prose); notes in () and 〈〉 are removed; within each chunk, pieces over 16 characters are left out. Review round 1 also brought back day 5's 金環之旅[平格費利爾國家公園 (15 once its D5 marker is gone; not reported, over 8 characters) and day 13's 乘坐Sija Line//Viking Line Cruise前往赫爾辛基 (its Latin words are short pieces), which adds 乘坐Sija to the unmatched names; its 赫爾辛基 joins day 14's, so the route does not change. Day 5's 古佛斯瀑布】 keeps a stray 】 (its opening [ was in the dropped lead chunk) and is reported unmatched with it. Unmatched names are reported only for 2 to 8 characters, so longer attraction names (賽爾約蘭特霍斯瀑布) do not appear; 市內觀光 is one of the shared ignored words.
